mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_canvas_node_run(id, run_id, node_id, parent_node_run_id, item_index, attempt, ordinal_no, fingerprint, plan_json, input_json, output_json, checkpoint_json, status, next_run_at, created_at, updated_at) SELECT #{id}, run_id, node_id, id, #{index}, #{attempt}, ordinal_no, #{fingerprint}, #{plan}, #{input}, #{output}, '{}', 'READY', UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM afv_canvas_node_run WHERE id = #{parentId}

INSERT INTO afv_canvas_node_run(id, run_id, node_id, ordinal_no, fingerprint, plan_json, output_json, checkpoint_json, next_run_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.runId}, #{row.nodeId}, #{row.ordinalNo}, #{row.fingerprint}, #{row.planJson}, #{row.outputJson}, '{}', UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM afv_canvas_node_run WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT n.* FROM afv_canvas_node_run n JOIN afv_canvas_run r ON r.id = n.run_id WHERE r.canvas_id = #{canvasId} AND n.node_id = #{nodeId} AND n.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND n.item_index = -1 ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT n.* FROM afv_canvas_node_run n JOIN ( SELECT n.id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY n.node_id ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC) AS position_no FROM afv_canvas_node_run n JOIN afv_canvas_run r ON r.id = n.run_id WHERE r.canvas_id = #{canvasId} AND n.parent_node_run_id IS NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(n.plan_json, '$.action')) <> 'REUSE' ) latest ON latest.id = n.id AND latest.position_no = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_canvas_node_run SET status = #{status}, input_json = #{input}, output_json = #{output}, checkpoint_json = #{checkpoint}, external_kind = #{kind}, external_id = #{externalId}, error_msg = #{error}, owner_instance_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_run_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{delay}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE afv_canvas_node_run SET owner_instance_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_run_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{seconds}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM afv_canvas_node_run WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND owner_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

SELECT current_node.id FROM afv_canvas_node_run current_node WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND (status IN ('READY','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED','NEEDS_REVIEW','UNKNOWN_SUBMISSION') OR (status='WAITING_CONFIRMATION' AND external_kind='AGENT')) AND next_run_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND (status <> 'READY' OR #{externalCount} < #{parallelism}) AND (status <> 'READY' OR parent_node_run_id IS NULL OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(plan_json,'$.node.kind')) NOT IN ('agent','scriptParse','storyToScript','episodeParse','storyboardGenerate','assetExtract','assetImageGenerate','frameGenerate') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM afv_canvas_node_run earlier WHERE earlier.parent_node_run_id=current_node.parent_node_run_id AND earlier.item_index<current_node.item_index AND earlier.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','PARTIAL_FAILED','FAILED','BLOCKED','CANCELLED'))) ORDER BY next_run_at, ordinal_no, item_index, attempt LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_canvas_node_run SET owner_instance_id = #{owner}, owner_epoch = owner_epoch + 1, lease_until = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, 90, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE afv_canvas_node_run SET lease_until = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, 90, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id = #{id} AND run_id = #{runId} AND owner_instance_id = #{owner} AND owner_epoch = #{epoch} AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (status IN ('READY','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED','NEEDS_REVIEW','UNKNOWN_SUBMISSION') OR (status='WAITING_CONFIRMATION' AND external_kind='AGENT'))
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM afv_canvas_node_run n JOIN afv_canvas_run r ON r.id = n.run_id WHERE r.canvas_id = #{canvasId} AND n.parent_node_run_id IS NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(n.plan_json, '$.action')) <> 'REUSE' AND n.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','PARTIAL_FAILED','FAILED','BLOCKED','CANCELLED') AND n.node_id IN #{id})
